title: OpenWarrant Format 1.0: check and kpi records
description: Hand-written and normative for docs/format/FORMAT-1.0.md section 12. Where this schema and the prose disagree, the prose wins and this schema is the defect. A check is an authored record (record.json) of type `check`: `run` is REQUIRED (a command run by `sh -c` in the repository root, or `gate://<id>@<version>`); `on` (triggers, comma-separated, default `done`), `timeout` (seconds, default 600) and `gating` (`true` by default, or `false`) are OPTIONAL. A kpi is a check that measures (type `kpi`): it adds a REQUIRED `direction` (`min` or `max`), an OPTIONAL `target` (shape `number`), and `mode` (`threshold`, `best` by default, or `optimise`). The items and obligations a check evaluates are `evaluates` relations, never fields. `reopen` (`true` or `false`; default true for commit/path/PR/CI/schedule watchers, false for manual/done checks) reopens a done item the check evaluates when the check turns `failing`. Not expressed here: that each trigger is one of the table's or a dotted extension trigger, and that a `schedule:` trigger carries a five-field cron expression.

propertyNames.description: The fields section 12 defines, or a dotted extension field.
